translated: Back when I was in elementary or middle school, we had off until the 31st, so around this time I'd be thinking I could still handle the homework...
I probably thought I could still get away with not doing it yet.
Yeah, on the 28th, you still feel like you're fine.
That's when you'd start getting serious.
The internal bargaining is about to begin.
But some people have school today, so good luck to you all.
So for those who've already started, I guess they have tomorrow off again.
Well, let's do our best with that homework.
Wait, were you the type to finish it early?
I'd pile it all up until the very last minute, thinking I was fine, and just end up strangling myself with work.
Every year on the 31st, I'd be crying while writing my independent research project with a certain 24-hour TV show playing in the background.
They always tell you that independent research is something you should plan out, but there's a certain charm to writing it at the end...
